english.title: Fail to comply with conditions of consent granted when carrying dangerous goods in Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnel areas
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE..) carrying dangerous goods, namely **(..SPECIFY DANGEROUS GOODS..) in the

(A)_[Blackwall]_
(B)_[Silvertown]_

tunnel area and having been granted consent to do so by the Transport for London, failed to comply with conditions of such consent in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 8(2) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a motor vehicle carrying dangerous goods
in the Blackwell / Silvertown Tunnel area
with the consent of Transport for London
drove into the tunnels without an escort directed or required by an authorised person OR
failed to take and comply with the directions and precautionary measures that an authorised person felt was expedient in the circumstances OR
failed to be accompanied by a person legally entitled to drive the motor vehicle, who was capable of stopping the motor vehicle in the event of sudden illness or incapacity and overtaking the driver while in the tunnel
